summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases, a rdf:nil test, a None/string input test, a graph-unchanged test, and a cyclic rdf:rest ValueError test. Ran with the generator venv: test_shacl.py plus test/test_path.py passed; test/test_extras plus test/test_path.py gave 121 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement, import order, and formatting were checked by reading only (line lengths checked by awk, all within 88).
